findings: The evaluation producer accepts only a declared pilot/quality slot request, hash-bound completed training/export outputs, exact raw/H200 locations, summary, corpus and training contract. Strict MPS is required; no CPU fallback branch or CLI exists.

Each endpoint owns and releases its CPU payload, rebuilt tokenizer loader and model before the next endpoint. Model state finiteness, checkpoint config/step/layout, raw training contract, H200 parent/half-life and inference-only semantics are checked. Tokenizer and exact96 training token IDs are checked before model allocation.

Validation alone uses128 context, batch8 and2048-token blocks; exact34278 targets and111536 bytes plus score arithmetic are checked. The existing descriptive H200 ROMEO sample settings are preserved and are not a selector. No test_data field is accessed.

Bounded immutable attempt/result/failure records preserve changing-input and output-cap failures and prevent retry. Input hashes and STOP are rechecked before and after endpoint operations and after result publication.

Pilot and quality stage binders now reject any failed or partial training/evaluation output even if supplied in the complete evidence inventory. This prevents a post-publication failure from being accepted merely because a result file exists.

Synthetic tests used actual tiny checkpoint files and fake MPS/model/validation/sample operations; weak-reference checks verified serial model release. Coverage, bytes, tokenizer, tokens, nonfinite tensors, bad parent lineage, changed input, missing MPS/fallback, generation failure, bounded result overflow and retry rejection passed.
limitations: No research corpus training, actual MPS validation/cache operation, nine-case numerical optimizer/update/resume/EMA suite, pilot or quality trial ran. These tests are preparation only.

The caller still must bind the complete frozen campaign and source/runtime, actual numerical/input reviews, full remaining storage, inherited locks and independent resource guard. This function is not a worker launcher or dispatch authorization.

The complete v2 worker must connect training/export, this evaluation producer, cache audit and resource completion, persist all provenance references and run stage/inference acceptance. Mandatory successful evaluation-attempt provenance binding into that complete worker/controller remains to be wired; current stage checks reject failures and continue their independent result/tensor/resource audits.

Full raw checkpoint loading and wider export/evaluation memory feasibility remain unproven. No research checkpoint deletion, storage-guard bypass, plan freeze, failed numerical-fixture retry or closed-campaign rerun occurred.
